A1.justification: Both complete 43-page PDFs describe the same LD-FPG research. Text and rendered-page comparisons cover the main paper and Appendices A–I, with no material reading gaps.

before.justification: v1 reports original D2R molecular dynamics data, model reconstruction and generation results in Tables 1–3, and extensive experimental ablations and parameter sweeps in Appendix I.

after.justification: v4 retains the original D2R simulations, model evaluations, and appendix experiments. These remain original empirical results despite being unchanged from v1.

M1.justification: The ChebNet encoder, reference conditioning, three pooling strategies, DDPM, losses, and generation procedures are unchanged in Section 3 and Appendices A–E and I.

E1.justification: Both versions use the same described D2R-MD trajectory and full-heavy-atom conformational generation task. The revised dataset address is not accompanied by any change to the represented data or task coverage.

E2.justification: The evaluated pooling and fine-tuning variants in Tables 1–2, BioEmu comparison in Section 4.2, and conditioning comparators in Table 17 are identical.

E3.justification: Both retain the chronological 90/10 split of 11,017 training and 1,224 test frames, evaluation metrics, training settings, and residue-pooling checkpoint aggregation described in Appendices F, H, and I.

E4.justification: The encoder ablations in Table 6, decoder and diffusion sweeps in Tables 8–16, conditioning ablation in Table 17, and dihedral/PCA/A100 analyses are unchanged.

E5.justification: Appendix I.10 retains the same per-structure lDDT and TM-score standard deviations and calculation procedure. There are no changes to run-count, seed, uncertainty, or significance reporting.

E6.justification: Numerical results, plotted findings, and appendix result entries are identical. For example, Table 2 retains all-atom lDDT values of 0.719, 0.712, and 0.6880 for blind, sequential, and residue pooling, respectively.

T1.justification: Mathematical definitions, ChebNet and diffusion formulations, loss equations, sampling algorithm, and appendix assumptions and calculations are unchanged.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction contributions, and conclusion retain the same novelty, system-specific ensemble generation, structural fidelity, and side-chain modeling claims.

C2.justification: Both versions retain the same pooling tradeoffs, steric-clash concerns, residue-pooling multi-epoch sampling limitation, generalization goals, and interpretation of ensemble variability.

D1.justification: Appendix I.1 changes the D2R-MD access link from Zenodo record 15479781 to record 16582853. The dataset description, code link, and implementation details remain unchanged; the PDFs do not establish any change in resource contents or accessibility.

R1.justification: The related-work discussion, cited works, and positioning relative to earlier protein structure and ensemble generators are unchanged.

P1.justification: v4 adds funding acknowledgments on page 10, marks Patrick Barth and Pierre Vandergheynst as additional corresponding authors, and replaces the NeurIPS 2025 footer with 'Preprint. Under review.' The scientific prose and section organization remain unchanged.

P2.justification: Visual changes are limited to title-page metadata and the new acknowledgment heading and text block on page 10. Figures 1–4 and Tables 1–17 retain identical content, formatting, and placement.

improvement.justification: v4 adds funding attribution and updates author/publication metadata and the dataset address. The scientific reasoning, empirical evidence, limitations, and technical guidance remain unchanged throughout the main paper and appendices. The PDFs do not establish improved data access, so these limited administrative updates do not materially change overall paper quality.
